definitions.gloss: high praise; positive rating; favorable evaluation
definitions.explanation: A positive assessment or high rating of something. Very common in online reviews, product evaluations, and performance assessments.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{高評価|こうひょうか}だ。
{高評価|こうひょうか}のレストランを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a highly rated restaurant.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}はレビューで{高評価|こうひょうか}を{得|え}ており、{売|う}り{上|あ}げも{好調|こうちょう}だ。
examples.english: This product has received positive reviews and its sales are doing well.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in modern Japanese, especially in the context of online reviews, ratings, and evaluations. Often used as a no-adjective: {高評価|こうひょうか}の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高評価|こうひょうか}を{得|え}る (to receive high praise)
- {高評価|こうひょうか}の{商品|しょうひん} (a highly rated product)
- {高評価|こうひょうか}レビュー (positive review)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好評|こうひょう}: favorable reception — similar but emphasizes popularity
- {低評価|ていひょうか}: negative rating — the opposite
